questions.name: q1
questions.instructions:
Does the document quote the user's original words without a change, in a place of their own? If the document is a plan or a result and carries a section with the user's words as quotes, answer yes.

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q2
questions.instructions:
Completion conditions: is the reinforcement, such as an extra observation or a later check, kept in its own section and not listed among the completion conditions? Answer yes if the document has no reinforcement or no completion conditions.

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q3
questions.instructions:
Does every appendix block that shows the full text of a file hold the text of that file and nothing else? If the document shows no full text of a file in an appendix, answer yes.

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q4
questions.instructions:
Opening paragraph: with only the first paragraph read, can a reader say in one sentence what the document asks to approve?

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q5
questions.instructions:
Approval request: does the sentence that asks for the approval list the approval scope as items, and do those items match the items in the body?

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q9
questions.instructions:
Revision history: does the body avoid describing earlier revisions of this document, such as what an earlier draft or revision said, what this revision changed, or why its wording changed? Measurements and facts that the work found, and quotes of the user's words or feedback, are not revision history. Answer yes if the body does not describe earlier revisions.

True means: Yes
False means: No

questions.name: q10
questions.instructions:
Cross reference: when a sentence points to a section or an appendix of this document, does that place hold what the sentence says it holds? For example, if a sentence says that the approval items are in section 11, section 11 must be the approval request. References that name another document do not count. Answer yes if the document has no such reference.

True means: Yes
False means: No
